protocol.score: same selection score as training, including both-context strict-revisit bonus
protocol.method: central finite differences on discovery worlds, normalize the linear combination of Gaussian unit directions, then test the signed estimate, parent and signed random directions on common independent holdout worlds. Only the inherited plastic tensor is perturbed.

verdict.criterion: Both lower bounds of the 95% paired-world intervals for selection-score gain must exceed zero against the parent and the average of the signed, equal-radius random directions.
